matches.rationale: No finding identifies the overstated linear relationship claim or lack of support for saturation in the Abstract.
No finding mentions the fabricated citation 'Grant, 2025' or the hunting in low-light environments claim.
No finding addresses the 5x7 whisker array zero-padding inconsistency.
No finding reports the absence of balancing hyperparameters across the two differently augmented whisking datasets.
No finding flags selective reporting of only the best model scores while omitting the full performance distribution.
No finding contests the overgeneralization that image augmentations cause training failure or lack of discussion about tuning them.
No finding points to the downplayed ethical reflection about dataset limitations constraining generalizability and reproducibility.
No finding questions the simulation clipping range of ±1 N relative to maximal bite forces.
No finding criticizes the missing detailed hyperparameter and hardware-balancing reporting for SSL training.
The finding about impossible Table 6 accuracy decimals does not address the suspicious zero accuracy values; no other finding covers this.
No finding describes undefined variables or skipped equation numbering in the IntersectionRNN appendix.
No finding contrasts the Abstract's saturation claim with the Discussion's admission of limited dataset diversity.
No finding challenges the speculative linking of modest GPT attender benefits to biological attention mechanisms.
No finding discusses failure to address biases from the small sample of 11 mice and 999 units.
The finding about S4 training instability differs from the ground-truth issue of unbalanced parameter counts and compute budgets across all baseline architectures.

Finding 8 reveals an inconsistency between published inter-animal consistency maxima (0.34 vs 1.34), and Finding 9 explicitly notes that model scores near 0.96 far exceed the 0.34 benchmark, implying overfitting or miscalculation. Together they capture the suspicious exceedance of the inter-animal ceiling described in the ground truth.
No finding identifies the fabricated claim of being the first direct neural comparison to rodent somatosensory cortex across 64 models.
